name: Click Synth Styles
author: Freek van Gool
description: Kits for Click Synth in ten styles: minimal techno, microhouse, techno, glitch, electro, breakbeat, ambient, industrial, dub techno and acid. Each kit has a groove in pattern A, a variation in B, a sparse breakdown in C and the groove with a fill in D. Loading a tune switches the device's own sequencer off, so you can audition the kit with your own sequencer; switch it back on to hear the groove stored in the tune. Drum and bass folders: Tech Step, Liquid DnB, Dancefloor DnB, Neurofunk, Jump Up, Jungle and Halftime DnB. Click and glitch kits with a one-bar groove in pattern A, a variation in B, a breakdown in C and a fill in D.
